summary: Example task gathers FRR config and hardware facts with frr.frr.frr_facts.
questions: How do I gather facts from an FRR router?

answer_card.title: Gather FRR facts
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Gather FRR facts
  frr.frr.frr_facts:
    gather_subset:
      - config
      - hardware
```
